_comment: Hot-path queries, asserted against EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN (acceptance test 8).
Each entry's `sql` must appear verbatim (modulo whitespace) inside the Swift
file named by `source`. check.mjs verifies that, so a query cannot be tuned
in Swift and silently drift away from the plan we assert here.

queries.name: inspection list (home screen)
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM inspection WHERE org_id = ? AND status = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY scheduled_at DESC LIMIT ?

queries.name: inspection list, all statuses
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM inspection WHERE org_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY scheduled_at DESC LIMIT ?

queries.name: open one inspection
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM inspection WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL

queries.name: checklist answers
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM observation WHERE inspection_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL

queries.name: answer lookup before write
queries.sql: SELECT id FROM observation WHERE inspection_id = ? AND item_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL

queries.name: findings for inspection
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM finding WHERE inspection_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order, id

queries.name: severity roll-up
queries.sql: SELECT severity FROM finding WHERE observation_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL

queries.name: next finding sort order
queries.sql: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), -1) + 1 FROM finding WHERE observation_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL

queries.name: photo grid
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM media WHERE inspection_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY captured_at DESC

queries.name: photo tray (unfiled)
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM media WHERE inspection_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL AND observation_id IS NULL AND finding_id IS NULL ORDER BY captured_at DESC

queries.name: photos for an observation
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM media WHERE observation_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order, id

queries.name: photo counts per item
queries.sql: SELECT observation_id AS oid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM media WHERE inspection_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL AND observation_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observation_id

queries.name: media upload queue
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM media WHERE sha256 IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL AND kind IN ('photo','video') ORDER BY captured_at LIMIT ?
queries.note: Idle-time digest worker. Not on any interactive path; a scan of a partial index here is acceptable and cheaper than carrying another index for it.

queries.name: canned comments — this item, ranked
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM canned_comment WHERE org_id = ? AND item_id = ? AND severity = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY use_count DESC, last_used_at DESC, id LIMIT ?

queries.name: canned comments — global top-up
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM canned_comment WHERE org_id = ? AND item_id IS NULL AND severity = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY use_count DESC, last_used_at DESC, id LIMIT ?

queries.name: template sections for snapshot
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM template_section WHERE template_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order, id

queries.name: template items for snapshot
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM template_item WHERE section_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order, id
